text: Ɓen non yedduɓe Alla, ko keeferaaku ngun hawti ɓe, yoga maɓɓe no walla yoga, gomɗimɓe ɓen wallindirtaa e maɓɓe. Si on wallindiraali e gomɗim- ɓe ɓen ayron e yedduɓe ɓen, wonanay gomɗimɓe ɓen fitina tawde ɓe heɓaali ko walla ɓe e yiɗɓe maɓɓe ɓen ka diina, wona kadi bone mawɗo ka leydi e sakkagol laawol Alla ngol.
